Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan are the openers for Pakistan. Bhuvneshwar Kumar has the new ball in hand and is raring to go.
... The Run Chase ...
Right then! The pitch is good for batting and Pakistan have a good batting line up as well. India though have a well-rounded bowling attack. We are in for yet another thrilling chase. Join us soon.

Pakistan did really well to come back into the game as they did because with the start they had with the ball, their pacers looked to be in for a long night. The trio of Naseem Shah, Haris Rauf and Mohammad Hasnain were spitting fire but the ball was coming on a bit too well onto the bat and they were hit away with ease. It was the repair work done by the spinners in the middle overs that really paved the way for the pacers to come back in later on get wickets. Mohammad Nawaz and Shadab Khan were brilliant and Pakistan will keep in mind that this total is definitely getable.

India got off to an absolute flier with both openers taking a liking to the raw pace of the Pakistani bowlers. They managed to score 62 runs inside the Powerplay and having lost just their skipper, they were on course for a big total. KL Rahul got out soon after and after that it was only Virat Kohli who stayed on the crease as the wickets kept tumbling. With the score at 93/2 at the halfway mark, India would have looked to get to the 200-run mark but the middle order failed. Kohli ended up with 60 runs and India somehow managed to scrape over the 180-run mark which is a par score given how the pitch is playing.

A brilliant contest between bat and ball in the first half but on the whole, India will be happier of the two sides going into the break as they have the late momentum with those two late boundaries. Pakistan though did really well to restrict India well below 200.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Two pieces of really poor fielding from Fakhar Zaman has seen India end the innings with a couple of boundaries. A low full toss, wide of the off stump, Ravi Bishnoi slashes it aerially towards deep point. Zaman comes in from the deep and ends up overrunning the ball. Zaman tries to adjust and take the take behind him but the ball goes off the palms and trickles into the fence. A brilliant over by Haris Rauf is ruined and India finish with 181/7!

FOUR! An attempted yorker from Haris Rauf but ends up bowling a low full toss. Ravi Bishnoi slices it through point. Fakhar Zaman charges it early and misfields it. The ball races away the fence. This might turn out costly for Pakistan.
Ravi Bishnoi walks in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! Fuller one on middle, Virat Kohli flicks it to square leg and calls for two. Asif Ali is quick to collect it and makes a direct hit. The decision is taken upstairs. The replay shows that Virat Kohli was just out of his crease and he walks out after a good knock!

Is that a run-out? An absolute bullet of a throw from the deep by Asif Ali and he gets in the direct hit at the striker's end. Virat Kohli seems to be struggling here and the umpires go upstairs. The replays show that the dive didn't save Kohli and he has to walk back.
Yorker and on middle, Virat Kohli looks to play at it but doesn't connect well. Another dot.
Slightly shorter and on off, Virat Kohli pulls it. The ball lands short of the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Virat Kohli denies the single.
Fuller one outside off, Virat Kohli looks to loft it but gets an inside edge towards the keeper. Dot.
Wide! This one lands outside leg, Virat Kohli leaves it alone.
Haris Rauf to bowl the final over of the innings.
Fuller one on middle, Virat Kohli drills it to long on for one.
Yorker and on middle, Virat Kohli digs it towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Touch fuller and on middle, slower too, Deepak Hooda lofts it but the ball hits the upper part of his bat. The ball goes high up in the air towards long on. Mohammad Nawaz settles under it and takes a good catch falling behind. Deepak Hooda walks out for 16 and Naseem Shah gets a wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Naseem Shah

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one this time, on off, Virat Kohli drives it towards deep covers for one.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Virat Kohli dances down the track and awkwardly pulls it to backward square leg for a brace. Good running!
Shorter one on off, Deepak Hooda looks to slap it but miscues it to third man for one.

SIX! Take a bow, Virat Kohli. On a length and on off, Virat Kohli uses the bottom hand and whips it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Fifty up for Virat Kohli and his good form in this tournament continues.
This one lands outside off, Virat Kohli looks to slap it but misses.
Fuller and on off, Deepak Hooda plays it towards backward point for one.
FOUR! Excellent shot. A good bouncer, at 146 clicks and over middle, Deepak Hooda bends his back, uses the pace of the ball and helps it over the keeper for a boundary.
Touch fuller and outside off, Deepak Hooda slices it through backward point for a couple. The fielder makes a good stop at the boundary line.
On a length again, Deepak Hooda lofts it over the mid off fielder. The fielder chases it down. They collect two.
Wide! Bowls a length ball outside leg, Deepak Hooda looks to flick it but misses.
Mohammad Hasnain is back on for his final over.
Goes fuller, around off, Virat Kohli nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a brace. He moves to 47 now.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Virat Kohli defends it back towards Haris Rauf.
Slightly shorter this time, outside off, Deepak Hooda caresses it to deep point for one.
FOUR! Fuller and on middle, Deepak Hooda creams it through extra cover for a boundary. A much-needed one for India.
On a length and on middle, Deepak Hooda eases it to the left of mid on. Dot.
Touch fuller and on off, Virat Kohli knocks it to mid off for one.
Haris Rauf (2-0-20-1) is back on.
Play and a miss. This one lands outside off, turns in and bounces a bit extra as well. Deepak Hooda looks to play at it but misses. A dot to end with. Good over for Pakistan.
Slightly shorter, Hooda looks to play at it but gets an outside edge towards short third man. Dot.
Fuller and outside off this time, Virat Kohli taps it to point for one again.
Another one down the middle, Hooda flicks it to mid-wicket for one more.
Bowls it on middle, Virat Kohli works it to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, outside off with a hint of turn, Virat Kohli cuts it to deep covers for a brace.
Short of length, on off. Deepak Hooda pushes it towards the point fielder for no run.

Slight halt in play! Mohammad Rizwan looks in a bit of trouble here. He jumps to collect a short ball but lands awkwardly on his right leg. The physio is out to have a look. He looks good to start now.

FOUR BYES! Wow, well that took off! Another cross-seamer by Mohammad Hasnain and with some serious heat behind it as well. This is just back of a length and over off, Deepak Hooda looks to get his head out of the way but the ball shoots up off the deck sharply. Mohammad Rizwan leaps up but to no avail and the ball runs away into the fence. Rizwan though seems to have hurt himself on the landing and we hope that he is fine.
Deepak Hooda is the next batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is a huge wicket for Pakistan. The man in form walks back to the pavilion without troubling the scorers. This a cross-seamer from Mohammad Hasnain short, around off. Hardik Pandya hops onto the back foot hits it straight to Mohammad Nawaz who takes a sharp catch down to his left at short mid-wicket. India now in a bit of a bother here.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Mohammad Hasnain

Commentary.Commentary: Banged in short and over middle, the pace is taken off though. Kohli gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length, into the leg stump. Virat Kohli comes down the wicket and hits it towards the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.

Good grab in the end by Haris Rauf! Short and wide, Kohli steps out and slashes it away to the right of third man. Rauf speeds to his right and almost overruns it but sticks out a left hand and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Lofted delivery, onto the stump. Hardik Pandya knocks it towards the bowler.
Hardik Pandya is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! A very, very soft dismissal this and Rishabh Pant will be disappointed with that. Tossed up at the stumps, Pant pre-meditates for the reverse sweep and in the end he can't get any power on it. Pant reaches for the shot and hits it early, off the toe end of the bat and straight towards cover-point. Asif Ali over there takes a simple catch and Shadab gets his first wicket of the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Asif Ali b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! That was full, outside off. Rishabh Pant didn't read the googly. Pant goes hard at the ball but gets an outside edge and races away towards the third-man region for a boundary.

Nicely flighted by Shadab, around middle, Virat Kohli gets in position for the slog-sweep but is early in his shot. The ball goes off the inner half and behind square on the leg side. They get a single.
A yorker-length delivery at the toes. Rishabh Pant comes down the pitch and knocks it towards long on for a single.
Shorter and outside off, punched away off the back foot towards wide long off for a single.
WIDE! Shadab Khan floats it up full and well outside off, the ball turns away as well and a wide is called.
Shadab Khan comes back into the attack.
Fuller length, around the middle stump. Virat Kohli pushes it towards the long-on fielder for a single.
Naseem keeps it short but pushes it outside off. Rishabh Pant drags this one towards deep square leg and collects a single.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. That was short, around off. Rishabh Pant pulls it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Drop and run! Around the top of off, dabbed down towards cover-point for a quick run.
Slower delivery, short of a length. Virat Kohli half-pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket and they run for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Classic Kohli! Hard length from Naseem Shah and around off, Virat Kohli comes down the pitch and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Fuller length, onto off stump. Rishabh Pant pushes it straight to the fielder at short mid-wicket. A dot to end the over.
Nawaz sees Pant stepping out and drags back the length a fair bit. This is around leg stump and Pant can only flick it towards short fine leg.
Short of a length, into the pads. Virat Kohli goes down the wicket and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Shortish length, around leg stump, Rishabh Pant walks towards the ball and works it leg side for one more.
Fuller length, around the pads. Virat Kohli works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Around the pads, Pant works it 'round the corner for a run.
Short of length, outside off. Virat Kohli knocks it to the fielder at the point for no run.
On the pads, Pant nudges it towards mid-wicket and picks up an easy single.
WIDE! And again! This time it's the attempted slower ball but down leg yet again. 100 is now up for India.
WIDE! A length ball, spilled way down leg and left alone for a wide.
Fuller length, onto the leg stump. Rishabh Pant pushes it to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Pitched up, around middle, Kohli mistimes the lofted drive down to long on for just a single.
FOUR! Virat you beauty! That was short, onto the stumps. Virat Kohli was quick to go on the back foot and pull it behind square leg for a boundary.

A bit of a mix-up in the middle but no harm is done. Length ball around middle and leg, Kohli tucks it towards mid-wicket and the batters start running. Rishabh Pant realizes that the fielder is close in and sends Kohli back. The throw comes in at the striker's end but there is no direct hit and Kohli is safe.

Drinks! Pakistan have been able to turn the tables this time and have removed the top three Indian batters here. India were off to a flying start but lost their first wicket in the sixth over. Till the seventh over both the Indian openers were back into the hut. Suryakumar Yadav came in but was not effective. India are currently 93/3 in the tenth over. Mohammad Hasnain comes to bowl the next over.
Short of a length, around off stump. Virat Kohli works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Switches to over the wicket now for the left-hander and bowls a flatter delivery on off. Rishabh Pant hangs back and pushes it out on the off side for one.
Rishabh Pant is the next batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Suryakumar Yadav holes out here and India lose their third wicket. On a length and around middle, SKY gets a big stride forward and looks for that lofted slog sweep. The ball though comes off the top edge and goes straight down the throat of Asif Ali at deep square leg. Ali holds on to a simple chance and SKY is unable to replicate his antics from the last game. Mohammad Nawaz gets into the wickets column too.
Commentary.Howout: c Asif Ali b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely flighted, around middle and leg. Virat Kohli tries to use his feet again but ends up heaving it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket for just a single.
Fuller length, at the stumps. Suryakumar Yadav sweeps it towards the square leg fielder for a single.
Nawaz pulls back the length and bowls it on off, Kohli steps out and drives it through mid off for a single.
Fuller length, onto the leg stump. Virat Kohli pushes it to square leg for a single. Kohli wants two but Suryakumar Yadav isn't interested.
On the shorter side and at the stumps, this is pulled away down to long on for one more.
Short and on off. Virat Kohli lofts it towards the long on fielder for a single.

FOUR! Just short and to add insult to injury, the ball runs away into the fence as well. Just a touch shorter and around off, turning away. Kohli looks for the extravagant drive but gets a thickish outside edge. Naseem Shah at backward point dives forward but the ball eludes him and it will be a boundary.
Fuller, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav goes hard at the ball but the fielder at covers gets a hand to it and stops a certain boundary. Just the single then.
Nicely tossed up, around off, Virat Kohli steps out and drills it down to long off for just a single.
Fuller length, onto the leg stump. Virat Kohli pushes it through mid-wicket for a single.
Excellent running! Around off, Kohli drives it on the up and towards long off. The batters push hard for two and get it with ease.
Fuller length, on off. Virat Kohli pushes it to the fielder at covers.
Length, angling it into middle, Virat Kohli blocks it off the front foot.
Fuller length, onto the off stump. Suryakumar Yadav pushes it through deep cover for a single.
FOUR! The lofted extra cover drive! Floated up, full and outside off, Suryakumar Yadav shimmies down the track and goes inside-out over extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! That was short, outside off. Virat Kohli was quick to go on the backfoot and hit it through mid-wicket for a boundary. A good way to end the over.
Quicker one, attacking the stumps, Suryakumar Yadav eases it in front of mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Short, outside off. That was quick. Suryakumar Yadav tries to cut that one but is beaten by the pace and the ball goes through to the keeper.

Play and a miss! Quicker and just a tad shorter, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav looks to cut off the back foot but the ball turns away and there is a bit of an extra bounce as well. SKY gets beaten past the outside edge.
FOUR! That's SKY for you! Slightly short, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav cuts it through point for a boundary.
Suryakumar Yadav walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! A wicket off the very first ball for Shadab Khan and India have now lost both their openers. Shadab tosses it up around leg stump, KL Rahul skips down the track and looks to smoke it over long on. But he doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball and ends up hitting it flat towards long on. Mohammad Nawaz over there takes an excellent low catch and Pakistan are slowly but surely making a comeback into the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Shadab Khan comes into the attack now.

Slower ball, fuller and outside off. KL Rahul pushes it to cover, but the overthrow by the fielder doesn't hit the stump and the fielder at short square leg misses to collect it. The batters steal a single. At the end of the Powerplay, India are 62/1!
Perfect length, on off, Rahul stays back and defends it out on the off side.
On a good length, outside off. KL Rahul knocks it but finds the fielder at covers. Dot.
Virat Kohli is off the mark! Good length, around off, Kohli bunts it out on the off side and picks up a quick single.
FIVE WIDES! Bangs a way shorter one on leg, Virat Kohli leaves it alone. The keeper fails to grab it as well as the ball races the fine leg fence. Bonus runs those for India.
On a good length, onto middle and leg. KL Rahul pushes it to mid-wicket for a single.
Virat Kohli is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Haris Rauf comes back strongly and does provide the breakthrough for Pakistan. Rauf rolls his fingers over the ball and serves it on a fuller length around off, Rohit Sharma goes too hard at it and looks to send it into orbit. It does go really high but off the toe end of the bat and around mid-wicket. Fakhar Zaman moves to his right from mid on and looks to grab it but the ball goes right through his hands. Luckily for Pakistan, Khushdil Shah is right beside him and the ball lands in his palms. Rohit departs after a quick start.
Commentary.Howout: c Khushdil Shah b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Who will bowl the final over of the Powerplay? It will be Haris Rauf!
Fuller again, KL Rahul lofts it but doesn't get the power right. The ball goes in the air and lands safely at long on. The fielder chases it. They collect two.
Fuller one, on middle, Rohit Sharma flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one again.
Slightly shorter this time down the leg side, KL Rahul moves across and works it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, KL Rahul eases it to covers.
FOUR! Fifty up for India in next to no time. Touch fuller and on off, KL Rahul drills it over mid off for a boundary.
Slightly shorter angling into the batter, KL Rahul shuffles across and eases it to covers. Dot.
Spin for the first time as Mohammad Nawaz has been brought into the attack.
A couple of dots to end an expensive first over by Haris Rauf, 12 coming off it. Length ball, pushed a bit wide outside off, Rohit stays back and dabs it towards point.
Goes full and straight now, Rohit Sharma eases it towards mid on.
Pacy delivery, around the top of off, KL Rahul plays it late and to the right of the fielder at third man for a run.
Good length this time, angling it into the body. Rohit tucks it leg side and picks up a single.
SIX! WOW! Rohit Sharma just knew a short ball was coming. It is shorter but at a very good height for the batter, around off and pulled all the way over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.

FOUR! No matter who the bowler is, the Indian batters are going after everyone. Rauf starts off with a fullish delivery around off, Rohit Sharma hangs back and just thumps it over wide mid off and picks up a boundary.
Haris Rauf comes in as first change.
SIX! Up and over! Fuller and on middle, KL Rahul lofts it down the ground between long on and long off for a maximum. Fantastic start for India.
Bowls it outside off, KL Rahul defends it to point. Dot.
On a length and outside off, Rohit Sharma looks to block it but gets an outside edge towards third man. The fielder makes a good stop at the boundary line. They collect one.
Fuller and on middle, Rohit Sharma flicks it but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
On a length and down the middle, KL Rahul gently flicks it to backward square leg for one.
SIX! KL Rahul joins the party now! This is fuller and on off, slower too, KL Rahul nonchalantly lofts it over the wide long off fence for a maximum.
Fuller one on middle, KL Rahul eases it to mid on for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the non striker's end but misses. One run.
Touch fuller and on off, KL Rahul lofts it but doesn't get the power right. It goes over extra cover. The fielder from inside the ring chases it. They collect two.
Hasnain is really steaming in now and bowls this one around 148 clicks! Good length again, Rohit Sharma eases it to mid on for one.
FOUR! Rohit Sharma has made up his mind here. This is on a length and on off, Rohit Sharma knocks it over mid off for a boundary.
Slightly shorter, at 146 clicks and with some extra bounce as well, Rohit Sharma looks to play at it but misses. Close!
Length ball down the middle, KL Rahul covers his line and guides it to third man. They cross.
Mohammad Hasnain to bowl from the opposite end.

SIX! KABOOM! Rohit Sharma gets the first maximum of the match in the very first over. This one lands on a length and on middle, Rohit Sharma heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Good start for India.
Good length and outside off, Rohit Sharma eases it to mid off. Dot.
FOUR! Up and over. Slightly shorter again, Rohit Sharma dances down the track and lofts it over extra covers for a one bounce boundary! Rohit is off the mark in style.
Slightly shorter this time and just outside off, Rohit Sharma makes a tight leave.
On a length again, outside off, KL Rahul guides it past backward point and gets off that mark. Single is taken and India are underway!
Naseem Shah starts right on the money! It is a length ball outside off, KL Rahul defends it to point. A dot to start with.

We are done with the pre-game formalities and it is now time to play! The umpires are out in the middle as the Pakistani players can be seen in a huddle. The Indian opening pair of KL Rahul and Rohit Sharma too make their way out to the middle. Naseem Shah has been handed the new ball and is ready to speed in. Two slips in place as well. Let's play...

We are minutes away from the start of play but as is the norm in these multi-nation tournaments, the two sets of players will first lineup for their respective national anthems. It will be Pakistan's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of India.

Hardik Pandya is down for a quick chat. He says that he needed a break and had a good rest in the last match. Further says that he has got a good training session for this big game and he feels refreshed. Adds that he loves the crowd around but his wife and his family are not around. Finishes by saying that he is the kind of person that sits in the room and tastes different food items but now he is more focused on the game and needs to be calm and win the game.

PITCH REPORT - Sanjay Manjrekar is pitchside. He says that there is an even covering of grass on this one. Wasim Akram joins him and says that it is totally different from Sharjah, it is slightly drier but there will be good carry and the team winning the toss should look to bowl first. Also goes on to add that there hasn't been any dew so it won't matter that much.

The Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma says that they would have bowled first as well. Further says that they need to play well and assess a good score. Adds that they have to be good from the start and not worry about external pressure. Says that injury is something that they cannot control and Ravindra Jadeja has been ruled out. Finishes by saying that Hardik Pandya comes back to the team and Deepak Hooda and Ravi Bishnoi will start as well.

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan says that they will bowl first. Adds that for them it is important to put pressure on India. Further says that they have a lot of takeaways from their previous loss against India. Ends by saying that the message for the boys is to play well and give their best. Says that Mohammad Hasnain comes in for Shahnawaz Dahani.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Khushdil Shah, Iftikhar Ahmed, Shadab Khan, Asif Ali, Mohammad Nawaz, Haris Rauf, Naseem Shah and Mohammad Hasnain (In for Shahnawaz Dahani).

India (Playing XI) - KL Rahul, Rohit Sharma (C), Virat Kohli, Suryakumar Yadav, Rishabh Pant (WK), Deepak Hooda (In for Ravindra Jadeja), Hardik Pandya (In for Dinesh Karthik), Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Ravi Bishnoi (In for Avesh Khan), Yuzvendra Chahal and Arshdeep Singh.
TOSS - The crowd is electric and the two captains are out in the middle for the toss. Babar Azam calls it correctly and Pakistan will BOWL first.
